title: Tom Holland speaks about the new Spider-Man movie – level 1
paragraphs: A new Spider-Man movie comes to cinemas on July 31. It is called Spider-Man: Brand New Day. In the story, Peter Parker is very lonely because nobody remembers him.

Actor Tom Holland says that the film shows why we need friends and help from other people. Spider-Man meets new friends in the story, including The Punisher and Bruce Banner. Actress Sadie Sink is also in the film. Her character is a big secret.
The director says that people should not try to find out everything before watching. He wants fans to enjoy the big surprises together in the cinema.
